analysis.emptyBody: Or paste one, press Choose…, or right-click a picture in Media → Open in Media Analysis. It is read on this PC; nothing is uploaded.
analysis.unsupported: Media Analysis reads PNG, JPEG and WebP pictures.
analysis.videoSoon: Videos open in the frame picker, which is coming next.
analysis.noMade: This picture carries no generation settings.
analysis.setupBody: Tags come from an image tagger that runs on this PC's processor, so it never takes GPU memory from your models. Set up once:
analysis.setupRuntime: Installs a small private runtime for the taggers (about 300 MB, kept apart from ComfyUI).
analysis.setupDownload: Downloads the WD v3 EVA02 tagger ({size} GB, Apache-2.0) into your models folder, under taggers.
analysis.setupFound: Uses the taggers already in your models folders: {names}.
analysis.noModels: No models folder is set. Choose one under Backend → Folders first.
